title: Correct time expression
description: Essential: The answer for part (1) must be the sum of two half-periods, yielding t = (1 + 1/λ)πm/(B₀q).

title: Correct distance expression
description: Essential: The answer for part (2) must be the difference of two diameters, yielding d = (1 - 1/λ) * 2mv₀/(B₀q).

title: Period formula application
description: Important: The student must correctly apply the cyclotron period formula T = 2πm/(Bq) for each region.

title: Path geometry recognition
description: Important: The student must recognize that the particle completes a half-circle in each region before velocity realigns with +x.

title: Radius formula usage
description: Important: The student must correctly use the radius formula R = mv/(Bq) to find the displacement in part (2).

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: The final expressions should have correct units for time (seconds) and distance (meters).

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the distance is incorrectly added (2R₁ + 2R₂) instead of subtracted.

title: Period summation error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if full periods are summed instead of half-periods for the time.
